༄༅/ /lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/de kho na nyid du sgrub pa spros bral mthar phyin bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ de kho na nyid du sgrub pa spros bral mthar phyin bzhugs so//

sangs rgyas sku dngos bla ma ni// ngo bo nyid sku la btud nas// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las// spros bral mthar phyin sgrub pa bshad// gsang sgrub lam rtags tshad phebs nas// spros pa gzhan skyong ngo bo nyid// ma bcos rang bzhin bsgrub pa ni// dang po rang byin brlab pa'i phyir// mdun mkhar gyad dang seng chen ni// brgyad kyis bteg pa'i khri steng du// ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// rnam pa dus gsum sangs rgyas te| |dbus su ston pa shākya'i gtso// sa gnon mnyam bzhag gser gyi mdog /g.yas su 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gtso// mar me mdzad ni li khri'i mdog /g.yon du ma 'ongs sangs rgyas gtso// byams mgon mi pham byi ru'i mdog /kun kyang longs sku'i cha lugs can| |dbu skra lcang lo gtsug tu 'khyil// rin chen rgyan mang du ma yis// dbu dang snyan mgul phyag zhabs dang*// se mo do dang do shal dang*// ska rags sogs rgyan dar sna tshogs// lhab lhub g.yo lding 'phur ba'i tshul// 'od lnga 'khrugs pa'i klong du bzhugs// de rnams gnas lngar yi ge ni| |oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing dang*// swā ser hā ljang gis mtshan bsam// gus pas mchod cing bstod par bya// dad mos brtan pos gsol ba gdab// de tshe lha gsum dpral ba yi// oṃ dkar gsum las 'od 'phros pa// gsum bsgril rang gi dpral bar thim// sku yi yon tan rdzogs par bsam// slar yang gsol btab mgrin pa nas// 'od dmar gsum bsgril rang mgrin thim// gsung gi yon tan rdzogs par bsam// slar gsol btab pas thugs ka nas// 'od mthing gsum bsgril rang nyid thim| |thugs kyi yon tan rdzogs par bsam// slar yang gsol btab lte ba nas// 'od zer gsum bsgril rang lter thim// yon tan dngos grub rdzogs par bsam// slar yang gsol btab gsang ba nas// 'od ljang gsum bsgril rang nyid kyi// gsang bar thim pas phrin las kyi// yon tan ma lus kun rdzogs bsam// slar yang gus pas gsol btab tshe// 'das dang ma 'ongs gtso la thim// gtso bo 'od lnga'i thig ler gyur// rang gi tshangs pa'i bu gar byon// lus nang gang bas dus gsum gyi// sangs rgyas rnams dang dbyer med bsam| |rang byin brlabs pa ches zab bo// thun dang po'o// de nas lam gyi dngos gzhi ni/

seng gyad glang po rta mkha' lding*// brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin chen khrir// sna tshogs chu skyes zla nyi'i steng*// rang nyid bla ma'i skur gyur pa// ngo bo nyid sku ratna shrī// gangs la nyi shar ji bzhin sku// lhun sdug 'od 'bar gzi brjid can// mtshan dpe kun rdzogs gsal stong nyid// bka' rtags sgom zhwa dmar po dang*// mthang gos bla gos snam sbyar bcas// mtshams sprin dbang po lta bu'i mdog /phyag gnyis mtheb srin so so ru| |sbyar zhing sprad pa drang nges kyi// chos 'khor bskor ba'i phyag rgya can// rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i// thugs nyid pad dkar 'dab brgyad pa// legs par rgyas pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng*// zla ba nya gang nyi ma'i dbus// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa ni// rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs pa// ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor snang*// de yi thugs nyid rin po che// pad rāg gur phub lta bu'i nang*// 'od lnga 'bar ba'i rdo rje ni// nas tsam rtse lnga rab mdzes pa// ting 'dzin sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs// de ltar sems dpa' gsum ldan pa'i// ngo bo nyid kyi bskyed rim la// gsal snang nges pa rnyed par bya// thun gnyis pa'o// de nas bzlas pa bya ba yang*// dang por mtshan bcas rdo rje'i bzlas// rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar po// rdo rje'i tha mar sngags 'dis bskor// oṃ āḥgu ru badzra dhṛka ྄ma hā mu dra siddhi pha la hūm̐/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ āḥgu ru bidyā dharma kīrti karma bi dza ya se na ma ma ma hā mu dra siddhi pha la hūm̐/ 'jig rten mgon po'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ āḥgu ru ratna shrī ma hā mu dra siddhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes dang dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying*// sngags rnams 'od lnga las grub cing*// 'od lnga 'phro zhing g.yas su 'khor// de las 'od 'phros 'gro rnams kyi// sgrib sbyangs bla ma'i go 'phang bkod// tshur 'dus sngags phreng la thim bsam// sngags rnams sbrel la brgya stong sogs| |mi dal mi myur ran par bzla// mtshan bcas rdo rje'i bzlas pa zab// thun gsum pa'o// mtshan med rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni// sngags phreng spro bsdu la sogs pa// dmigs pa snga ma ji bzhin la// sngags rnams g.yas su drag 'khor ba'i// 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i 'phags rnams kyi// thugs rgyud bskul zhing thugs rje dang*// byin rlabs nus mthu kun bsdus nas| |sngags phreng sa bon phyag mtshan la// thim pas gzi brjid 'bar bar bsam// sngags rnams ngag gis mi bzla bar// yid kyis ma yeng bzla bar bya// slar yang rdo rje hūm̐ bcas las// 'od mthing bdud rtsi rab 'phros pas// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku gang zhing*// de yi ba spu'i khung rnams nas// 'od mthing ches mang spros pa yis// 'jig rten gsum mgon sku nang khengs// de yi ba sbu'i khung rnams nas// 'od mthing bsgrang yas phyogs brgyar spros// rigs drug sems can yongs la phog

/de rnams kyi ni zhe sdang gi// sgrib sbyangs me long lta bu yi// ye shes mngon du gyur par bsam// de bzhin 'od zer spro bsdu yis// nga rgyal sbyangs nas mnyam nyid dang*// 'od dmar 'dod chags sor rtog dang*// 'od ljang phrag dog bya grub dang*// 'od dkar gti mug chos dbyings te// dmigs gsal sngags bzla ting 'dzin bsgom// mtshan med rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni// ye shes lnga rdzogs ches zab bo| |thun bzhi pa'o// de ltar kun rdzob rdor bzlas ni// thems nas yang dag don dam pa// rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'di byas te// sku dang sngags phreng gsal ba'i ngang*// 'od zer spro bsdu mi bya bar// gzugs snang thams cad bla ma'i sku// snang stong 'dzin med chu zla bzhin// sgra ru grag tshad bla ma'i gsung*// grag stong 'dzin bral rlung sgra bzhin// 'gro drug sems kun bla ma'i thugs// gsal stong 'dzin med nam mkha' bzhin// bden 'dzin a 'thas ther zug la// gang shar rang grol nyid kyi ngang*// ma yeng 'dzin med rtsa bral du// rang rig bla ma'i dgongs par blta// 'di ni yang zab dam pa'i lam// don dam rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o// thun lnga pa'o// slar yang bdag dang gzhan 'dzin gyi// 'khrul ba'i dri ma rtsad gcod phyir// bdag gzhan dbyings rig bsre ba ni// bdag gi sems nyid spros bral dang*// khams gsum sems can sems yid dang*// tha dad med par dbyer med ngang*// chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du// stong pa la ni stong pa bsre// de yang nam mkhar bltas pa'i tshe// gzhi med rtsa bral nam mkha'i khams// stong pa bdag med de nyid dang*// rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug nyid// mtha' bral ngo bor ro gcig ste// bsre bya sre byed med pa ru// dbyer med ngang du cham gyis bzhag /'di ni bdag gzhan tha dad du// 'dzin pa'i rtog pa 'gog byed pa// zung 'jug rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o// thun drug pa'o// mjug tu rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni// rang gnas sa bon 'od zer gyis// snod bcud bsdus nas rang la bstim// rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' ni// 'od zhu ye shes sems dpar bsdu// ye shes sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis// sems dpa' rdo rje de la thim// rdo rje stod smad nas bsdus pa// hūm̐ la thim zhing hūm̐ nyid kyang*// zhabs kyu khog pa mgo zla tshes// thig le nā da'i bar bsdus te// nā da gsal stong la gtad nas// dar cig mnyam bzhag slar yang ni// dmigs med ngang nas gtad med du// 'dzin med bsgoms pas rtog med 'grub// bsngo bas rgyas gdab spyod lam 'jug

/thun bdun pa'o// de ltar lam zab bla sgrub kyi// ngo bo nyid du sgrub pa'i thabs// spros pa kun bral mthar phyin pa// 'jig rten gsum mgon zhal gyi lung*// rang gi 'khrul bas ma bslad par// tshad mar bkod 'di 'bri gung pa// chos kyi grags pas bris pa'i dges// ma gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa// dag pa gnyis ldan thob par shog/ //maṅga laṃ//
